pages.quiz:
ENGLISH LANGUAGE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #18
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the family tree in the lesson, Amina's father's sister is her (1 mark)
   A. cousin
   B. grandmother
   C. aunt
   D. sibling

2. Which word ends with the sound /v/? (1 mark)
   A. leaf
   B. proof
   C. half
   D. leave

3. If you make a small mistake on a form, you should (1 mark)
   A. leave it
   B. draw one neat line through it and write the correct word
   C. tear the page
   D. scribble over it

4. 'Sleep like a log' means (1 mark)
   A. sleep in the forest
   B. wake up early
   C. sleep very deeply
   D. sleep very little

5. Which question is indirect? (1 mark)
   A. Where did she cry?
   B. Why do you think the girl cried?
   C. Who cried?
   D. When did the girl cry?

6. What is the plural of 'church'? (1 mark)
   A. churchs
   B. churchies
   C. churches
   D. churchen

7. What is the plural of 'baby'? (1 mark)
   A. babies
   B. babyes
   C. babys
   D. baby

8. Which is the best way to end a story? (1 mark)
   A. With nothing
   B. With a list of numbers
   C. With the word 'the'
   D. With a feeling or a lesson

9. Which is a greeting for the afternoon? (1 mark)
   A. Good night
   B. Good morning
   C. Good luck
   D. Good afternoon

10. What do we say when someone thanks us? (1 mark)
   A. You are welcome
   B. Excuse me
   C. I beg your pardon
   D. Congratulations

11. In 'listen', the silent letter is (1 mark)
   A. t
   B. s
   C. n
   D. l

12. First aid words: Which word has the sound /ɒ/? (1 mark)
   A. doctor
   B. bite
   C. snake
   D. pain

13. Pronouns: Choose the correct sentence. (1 mark)
   A. The nurse helped my.
   B. The nurse helped mine.
   C. The nurse helped I.
   D. The nurse helped me.

14. Which word goes before a noun to show ownership? (1 mark)
   A. hers
   B. mine
   C. my
   D. yours

15. A balanced diet is a diet that (1 mark)
   A. has no water
   B. has only sweets
   C. has only meat
   D. has the right amounts of all types of food

16. What does 'thin' mean? (1 mark)
   A. very old
   B. With little flesh on the body
   C. very fat
   D. very tall

17. In the story shape, the highest point is (1 mark)
   A. the date
   B. the title
   C. the last full stop
   D. the exciting part

18. Which is a rule for staying safe on the internet? (1 mark)
   A. Tell everyone your password
   B. Open messages from strangers
   C. Share your address
   D. Use it with a parent or teacher

19. Which noun is uncountable? (1 mark)
   A. chair
   B. pupil
   C. egg
   D. milk

20. Which sentence talks about a finished action in the past? (1 mark)
   A. Kamau buys data bundles every week.
   B. Kamau will buy data bundles tomorrow.
   C. Kamau bought data bundles yesterday.
   D. Kamau is buying data bundles now.

21. In the story 'The Boy and the Borrowed Phone', what did Otieno do with the strange message? (1 mark)
   A. He replied at once
   B. He showed it to his aunt
   C. He sent it to his class
   D. He typed his school name

22. Choose the correct -ing form of 'play'. (1 mark)
   A. playying
   B. plaing
   C. playing
   D. plaiing

23. Which of these is a proper noun? (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. town
   C. river
   D. hill

24. What does 'indigenous' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Grown in a factory
   B. Damaged by pests
   C. Belonging naturally to a place
   D. Very expensive

25. Which is the correct negative of 'He works on the farm'? (1 mark)
   A. He don't work on the farm.
   B. He doesn't works on the farm.
   C. He doesn't work on the farm.
   D. He isn't work on the farm.

26. Which sentence uses 'its' correctly to show belonging? (1 mark)
   A. The cow licked its calf.
   B. Its a fine day.
   C. I think its a goat.
   D. Its raining today.

27. What should you do before writing a narrative? (1 mark)
   A. Copy someone else's story
   B. Skip the beginning
   C. Write the ending only
   D. Make a short plan

28. In which word does the letter s say /z/? (1 mark)
   A. sit
   B. class
   C. easy
   D. sun

29. Which word is an adverb of time? (1 mark)
   A. upstairs
   B. yesterday
   C. quietly
   D. here

30. Which sentence puts the comma after the opening phrase? (1 mark)
   A. In the morning we, do exercises.
   B. In, the morning we do exercises.
   C. In the morning we do, exercises.
   D. In the morning, we do exercises.

31. Which is a polite way to interrupt a speaker? (1 mark)
   A. Excuse me, may I ask a question?
   B. Stop talking!
   C. Be quiet!
   D. You are wrong!

32. What should a person with diarrhoea do? (1 mark)
   A. Stop drinking water
   B. Stay away from clean water
   C. Drink plenty of safe water and see a health worker
   D. Share their cup

33. How long should you rub your hands when washing them, according to the text? (1 mark)
   A. About two seconds
   B. There is no time needed
   C. About twenty seconds
   D. About ten minutes

34. What does a referee do? (1 mark)
   A. Controls a game and makes sure the rules are followed
   B. Cleans the field
   C. Sells tickets
   D. Trains the team

35. Which is a fact that can be checked? (1 mark)
   A. Netball is the nicest game.
   B. Everyone should play netball.
   C. A netball team has seven players.
   D. Netball is boring.

36. Which is the correct spelling of the word used to give a reason? (1 mark)
   A. because
   B. becuase
   C. becouse
   D. becase

37. Which of these helps you speak fluently? (1 mark)
   A. Mumbling
   B. Practising what you want to say
   C. Speaking as fast as possible
   D. Never looking at the audience

38. In the telephone game, why is careful listening important? (1 mark)
   A. The message can change as it is passed on
   B. The first player wins by shouting
   C. The game is silent
   D. There is nothing to hear

39. Which preposition completes: 'I am afraid ____ thieves.'? (1 mark)
   A. of
   B. in
   C. to
   D. at

40. Which is the correct spelling of the word for a person who keeps money records? (1 mark)
   A. acountant
   B. accountant
   C. acounttant
   D. accountent

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Write one statement, one WH question and one yes or no question about email. Say how the voice moves in each. (3 marks)

42. Fill in this form line with your own details in block letters: Name, Grade, School. (Write an example.) (3 marks)

43. Explain what the proverb 'Many hands make light work' means and give an example. (3 marks)

44. Explain what the saying 'A stitch in time saves nine' teaches. (2 marks)

45. Write an invitation of three sentences to a wedding or birthday party, using 'invite' and 'decorate'. (3 marks)

46. Write two words that contain /ɛə/, two that begin with /j/ and one that has /ʒ/. (5 marks)

47. Compose a tongue twister with at least six words that contain the sound /w/. (3 marks)

48. Plan a composition called 'My School Compound' by saying what goes into each of three paragraphs. (3 marks)

49. Explain the proverb 'A stitch in time saves nine'. (2 marks)

50. Write a sentence that has an adverb of manner, an adverb of time and an adverb of place. (3 marks)

51. Read: 'Juma asked his mother to add vegetables to his lunch.' Say why Juma did this, using the story 'A Pot of Vegetables'. (2 marks)

52. Give a situation in which 'Prevention is better than cure' applies. (2 marks)

53. Choose the correct word in each: (a) I (know / no) the answer. (b) They put (their / there) bags (their / there). (3 marks)

54. Write three sentences about your classroom using some, any and many. (3 marks)

55. Write a diary entry of about 60 words about a day at school. Include the date, feelings and a plan for tomorrow. (5 marks)

56. Write a title and an opening sentence for a story about a girl who finds a lost phone. (2 marks)

57. Write three sentences using three of these words: because, different, address, favourite, tomorrow. (3 marks)

58. Name three polite words or phrases and say when each is used. (3 marks)

59. Write four sentences about your family. Use a, an and the at least once. (4 marks)

60. Write one sentence using 'present' as a noun and one using 'present' as a verb. Show the stress with capital letters. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ENGLISH LANGUAGE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #18 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — aunt
   A father's sister is an aunt.

2. D — leave
   Leave ends with /v/. Leaf, half and proof end with /f/.

3. B — draw one neat line through it and write the correct word
   A neat single line keeps the form readable.

4. C — sleep very deeply
   A log does not move, so it means a deep sleep.

5. B — Why do you think the girl cried?
   The answer must be worked out from clues.

6. C — churches
   Nouns ending in ch add es.

7. A — babies
   A consonant comes before y, so change y to i and add es.

8. D — With a feeling or a lesson
   A good ending gives the reader a feeling or a message.

9. D — Good afternoon
   Good afternoon is used after midday.

10. A — You are welcome
   You are welcome is the polite reply.

11. A — t
   We say lisn, so the t is silent.

12. A — doctor
   Doctor has the short vowel /ɒ/.

13. D — The nurse helped me.
   Me is the object form of I.

14. C — my
   My comes before a noun. Mine stands alone.

15. D — has the right amounts of all types of food
   It has energy, body-building and protective foods and water.

16. B — With little flesh on the body
   Thin is the opposite of plump.

17. D — the exciting part
   Events rise to an exciting part.

18. D — Use it with a parent or teacher
   A trusted adult keeps you safe.

19. D — milk
   We cannot count milk one by one.

20. C — Kamau bought data bundles yesterday.
   'Bought' and 'yesterday' show the action is finished.

21. B — He showed it to his aunt
   He remembered his teacher's advice and asked an adult.

22. C — playing
   A verb ending in y keeps the y before -ing.

23. A — Mombasa
   Mombasa is the name of a particular town.

24. C — Belonging naturally to a place
   Indigenous plants and animals are native to a place.

25. C — He doesn't work on the farm.
   After doesn't, the verb returns to its base form.

26. A — The cow licked its calf.
   'Its' without an apostrophe shows belonging.

27. D — Make a short plan
   A plan helps organise beginning, middle and end.

28. C — easy
   The s in 'easy' is buzzed, like z.

29. B — yesterday
   'Yesterday' tells when.

30. D — In the morning, we do exercises.
   A comma follows the opening phrase.

31. A — Excuse me, may I ask a question?
   It is polite because it asks permission.

32. C — Drink plenty of safe water and see a health worker
   Drinking safe water and seeking help is important.

33. C — About twenty seconds
   Rub for about twenty seconds, then rinse.

34. A — Controls a game and makes sure the rules are followed
   A referee is the official in charge.

35. C — A netball team has seven players.
   A fact can be checked; the others are opinions.

36. A — because
   Because is spelt b-e-c-a-u-s-e.

37. B — Practising what you want to say
   Practice reduces hesitation.

38. A — The message can change as it is passed on
   The last player may hear a different message.

39. A — of
   We say 'afraid of'.

40. B — accountant
   Accountant has a double c.

SECTION B
----
41. (3 marks)
   Answer: I sent the email (falls). Where is the message? (falls) Did you get it? (rises)
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each with correct voice movement.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: Name: AMINA NJOROGE; Grade: 4; School: SUNRISE PRIMARY SCHOOL (any correct example).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each line in block letters.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: It means a job is easier when many people help. For example, the whole class can sweep the compound quickly.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the meaning, 1 for a suitable example, 1 for clear expression.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: It teaches us to fix a small problem early, before it becomes a big problem.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for fixing early and 1 mark for avoiding a bigger problem.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: I invite you to my sister's wedding on Saturday. We will decorate the hall with flowers. Please come at ten o'clock.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

46. (5 marks)
   Answer: /ɛə/: chair, care. /j/: yellow, young. /ʒ/: television.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: We watched worms wriggle when the wind whistled.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for a sentence, 1 for at least six /w/ words, 1 for making sense.

48. (3 marks)
   Answer: Paragraph 1: what the compound is and where. Paragraph 2: details such as trees, playground, buildings. Paragraph 3: how I feel about it.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each paragraph.

49. (2 marks)
   Answer: Fixing a small problem early stops it becoming a bigger problem that takes more work.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for fixing early and 1 for avoiding bigger work.

50. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Yesterday the children played happily outside.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct adverb.

51. (2 marks)
   Answer: Mama Zuri told him vegetables give vitamins that protect the body from sickness, so he wanted to stay healthy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for vitamins or protection and 1 mark for linking to Juma.

52. (2 marks)
   Answer: Washing hands before eating prevents illness, which is better than getting sick and needing medicine.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for a situation and 1 for linking it to the proverb.

53. (3 marks)
   Answer: (a) know (b) their, there
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct choice.

54. (3 marks)
   Answer: There are many desks in our classroom. We have some pictures on the wall. Is there any chalk?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

55. (5 marks)
   Answer: An entry in the first person with a date, events in order, feelings, a plan and a sign-off.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the date, 1 for events in order, 1 for feelings, 1 for a plan, 1 for correct tense and punctuation.

56. (2 marks)
   Answer: Title: An Honest Girl. One morning, Achieng found a phone near the school gate.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

57. (3 marks)
   Answer: Any three correct sentences using the words with correct spelling.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

58. (3 marks)
   Answer: Please: when asking. Thank you: when someone helps. Sorry: when we make a mistake.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each phrase with its use.

59. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example: I have a brother. He has an old bicycle. The bicycle is red. We ride it in the yard.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence that uses the articles correctly.

60. (3 marks)
   Answer: My uncle gave me a PRE-sent. I will pre-SENT the prize to the winner.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence and 1 mark for correct stress.
